content.descriptor: Korean vegan skincare: the PRINCIPLE line on licorice and hyaluronic acid, the CICAPINE™ line on pine and centella from Jeju, ampoules and targeted care
about: ABEREDE is a Korean brand of vegan derma-cosmetics. It is made by Lubedecacorn Global, a Seoul company registered on 10 November 2022.

The brand idea is simple and it is held to: the formulas are built from plant material taken from specific natural areas of Korea — from its land, its sea and its mountains. That is where the CICAPINE™ line comes from, built on pine and centella from the island of Jeju.

In three years the company has gathered what usually takes longer: two patents on formulations against pigmentation, a trademark registration, the status of an approved exporter by origin, and a place in the Global Small Giant 1000+ programme.
The products are carried in the duty free of the Hyundai department store and at Incheon airport, and the brand has shown at Cosmoprof in Bologna and Hong Kong, at KCON LA and at Dubai Beauty World.
facts: Lubedecacorn Global was registered on 10.11.2022; ABEREDE is its vegan derma-cosmetics brand
Two patents on cosmetic formulations against pigmentation and for brightening, both dated 29.08.2023
Approved exporter status by origin of goods and a place in the Global Small Giant 1000+ programme

The company states that its products reach 30 countries, among them the United States, Mexico, the CIS, the Middle East, South-East Asia and Indonesia

lines.name: PRINCIPLE
lines.note: The base hydration line in three steps: toner, serum and cream. The toner carries licorice extract and hyaluronic acid, the serum is stated at 30 per cent high-molecular hyaluronic acid, and the cream carries guaiazulene, a peptide complex and ceramides. It is these three products that hold irritation test reports with an index of 0.00.

lines.name: CICAPINE™
lines.note: The line for problem skin and enlarged pores, built on the brand's own CICAPINE™ ingredient: phytosterols from green pine and centella from the island of Jeju. The company names a patented FLEX_some™ delivery method and orthosiphon extract for pore care. The line covers a serum, a balancing gel cream and a micellar foam cleanser.

lines.name: Ampoules
lines.note: Three 30 ml ampoules for different jobs. NIA 10% with glutathione works on pigmentation by blocking, in the company's description, the movement of melanin from the basal layer to the surface. VOR is built on vorphyrin and five peptides for skin density. HYA with vitamin E covers hydration and antioxidant protection.

lines.name: Targeted care
lines.note: Products for one job each: the COLLAGEN 70 peel-off mask with 300 Da low-molecular collagen, glutathione and PDRN; a lifting eye cream on PCL and NMN; an overnight jelly lip mask on NAD and PDRN; a gel against dark spots for face and body; and an SPF50 PA++++ sunscreen.

tech.name: CICAPINE™ — pine and centella from Jeju
tech.note: The brand's own ingredient. The company names phytosterols obtained from green pine and centella from Jeju, together with a patented FLEX_some™ method which, by its data, helps active ingredients absorb.

tech.name: Two patents on anti-pigmentation formulations
tech.note: Both granted on 29 August 2023: a cosmetic composition for improving melasma and hyperpigmentation, and a composition with spot-removal and whitening function.

tech.name: Clinical reports with an index of 0.00
tech.note: Human Co., Ltd. Skin Clinical Trial Center, reports dated 27 September 2023 on the PRINCIPLE toner, serum and cream. Patch test, assessed by a dermatologist 30 minutes and 24 hours after patch removal. Irritation index 0.00, classified as non-irritating, with no adverse reactions recorded.

tech.name: Low-molecular collagen and PDRN
tech.note: In the COLLAGEN 70 mask the company states 70 per cent ultra-low-molecular collagen at 300 Da, 700 ppm of glutathione and PDRN, along with a patented blend of five fermented ingredients — soybean, rice, adlay, potato and ginseng — made by two-step fermentation.

tech.name: Vegan formulation and low-impact printing
tech.note: The brand is declared vegan and not tested on animals. Packaging, by the company's data, is printed with soy inks on FSC-certified paper.

formats: Toners and serums at 50 and 150 ml
content.exportNote: By the company's data the products reach 30 countries, among them the United States, Mexico, the CIS, the Middle East, South-East Asia and Indonesia. In its letter of 30 August 2026 the company said plainly what it is looking for: the war slowed its Middle East business and the brand is choosing new countries. Teranova works across Latin America and North America and matches the brand to countries and channels where documents on the formulation and test results are the first thing asked for.

content.seoDesc: ABEREDE — Korean vegan skincare with formulation patents and clinical reports: PRINCIPLE line, CICAPINE™ on Jeju pine and centella, ampoules, masks, SPF50.
catalog_notes: Principle Natural Rich Hydrated Toner — a highly concentrated toner on licorice extract and hyaluronic acid. The company states hydration and soothing. Irritation index in the laboratory report: 0.00.

Principle Natural Rich Hydrated Serum — a serum stated at 30 per cent hyaluronic acid. In the company's description it improves skin flexibility and gives a cooling effect. Irritation index in the report: 0.00.

Principle Natural Rich Hydrated Cream — a cream with guaiazulene and a peptide complex. The company states oil-water balance, work on wrinkles and brightening, with ceramides and hyaluronic acid holding moisture in. Irritation index in the report: 0.00.

CicaPine Forest Needle Energy Serum — a serum on green-pine phytosterols and centella from Jeju. The company names the patented FLEX_some™ delivery method, pore tightening and a restored skin balance.

CicaPine Calming & Pore Repair Balancing Gel Cream — a gel cream on the CICAPINE™ ingredient from pine and centella. In the company's description it soothes the skin, while orthosiphon extract helps with pore care.
CicaPine Micellar Acne Foam Cleanser — a foam cleanser built on the micellar principle. The company states that pine needle washes debris out of pores and that skin stays hydrated after washing.

NIA 10% Gluta Blemish Ampoule — an ampoule with 10 per cent niacinamide and glutathione against dark spots. In the company's description it blocks the movement of melanin from the basal layer to the surface.
VOR Peptide Revervity Ampoule — an ampoule on vorphyrin and five peptides. The company states work on skin density and firmness, with antioxidant and anti-aging effect.

HYA Vitamin E Antioxi Ampoule — an ampoule with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E. The company states a moisturising film, soothing and protection of dry skin from external factors, with a non-sticky finish.

COLLAGEN 70 Gluta Glow Peel-Off Mask — a cream-texture peel-off mask. The company states 70 per cent collagen at 300 Da, 700 ppm of glutathione and PDRN, plus five fermented ingredients from two-step fermentation.
PCL NMN Lifting Eye Cream — an eye cream on PCL and NMN. The company presents it as one product for several concerns around the eye: lifting, dark circles and tone.
NAD PDRN Jelly Lip Mask — an overnight lip mask of jelly texture on NAD and PDRN. The company states three jobs at once — exfoliation, hydration and volume — plus a protective film on the lips.
White Vita Aqua Shield Sun Screen — an SPF50 PA++++ sunscreen with vitamin E and hyaluronic acid. Chemical filters, a light non-sticky texture.

ui.products_note: Vegan derma-cosmetics in four groups: the PRINCIPLE base hydration line, the CICAPINE™ line on pine and centella from Jeju, three ampoules for different jobs, and targeted care from a mask to SPF50. Price on request.
